program.blurb: Yoga built around the core: boat, plank, side plank, dolphin and crow, between standing poses.
program.about: Yoga that builds the core: boat, plank, side plank, dolphin and crow held on the clock. Each session opens with sun salutations, spends its middle on core poses and closes with standing work and rest. Two days alternate with different core shapes. Level II holds longer and Level III moves to harder poses. The session is core work already, so there is no separate abs finisher.
program.split: Core flow A / core flow B
